newsitem.title: USA: Trinova sees positive, negative Q4 trends.
newsitem.headline: Trinova sees positive, negative Q4 trends.

text.p: Trinova Corp said Thursday that as it begins its fourth quarter, it sees positive trends in its air conditioning division, but continued weakness in industrial machinery.
The company did not provide specifics, and spokesmen were not immediately available for further comment.

The air conditioning segment includes residential and mobile units. The area of industrial machinery includes machine tools, plastics processing equipment and other markets for which orders have slowed with the company's distributors, it said.
However, Trinova said many of its customers are showing increased order intake, giving it optimism for the fourth quarter.

In the third quarter results reported Thursday, the company said its European industrial sales were down and that Brazil also hurt the results. But the quarter was helped by strong sales in the aerospace and automotive divisions, the industrial components and systems company said.

"Continued growth in automotive and aerospace sales, and order trends we are seeing with our industrial customers, give us confidence about prospects for the fourth quarter," Trinova Chairman, President and Chief Executive Darryl Allen said in a statement.
